content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and mapped.

**Highlights for the review team:**
- **Absent/inapplicable:** MFN (no MFN construct) and RENEWAL (fixed Term at 14.1, no auto-renewal mechanic).
- **Favourable, do not flag:** SFJ-side exclusivity at 3.19 (p0369–p0374); PB retention of Existing IP and Trial Inventions (11.1.1.1–11.1.1.3).
- **Priority review areas:** SFJ's ownership of the Trial Data Package under 11.1.1.4 (p0663) with repurchase pricing (p0489, p0750, p0755); the 300% termination multiples (p0764, p0769) under LD; PB's development-cost overrun exposure above the $120M cap (p0380–p0381); consent-based assignment plus change-of-control buy-out/termination (p0814, p0530, p0765); one-sided warranty allocation (SFJ gives only a funding covenant at 13.5); and Limitation of Liability at 15.11 read with the arbitral damages waiver at p0830.
- **Structural risk flagged for TRANSITION/IP workers:** the Program Transfer mechanism (p0376) operates in the opposite direction to normal exit assistance, transferring our program to SFJ on trigger events.
